messages:
Ella: FYI did a quick soak on /v1/embeddings with mixed-dim clients. found two pain points: a) extreme p95 when 512/2048 mixed; b) large JSON bodies cause gateway 413s on some edge nodes.
Jon: gateway 413s? are clients sending really large base64 vectors or huge arrays?
Ella: arrays. some customers POST 1000 vectors of dim=512 in one request. combined with metadata pushes payload > 10MB. edge rejects.
Priya: that matches earlier incidents. We cap at 8MB on nginx tier. need to either 1) reject with clear 413+explanation and suggested split plan or 2) accept with streaming multipart.
Sam: product question: do we want to recommend client-side split by bytes or by dim count? both affect routing. if we split by bytes we might mix dims and trigger latency cliffs.
Ella: proposal: preflight endpoint /v1/embeddings/preflight that returns 1) recommended split plan (chunks and shapes), 2) estimated cost & expected P95 per chunk, 3) header hint X-Embed-Shape: prefer-same or prefer-mix. cheap and idempotent.
Jon: sounds good. preflight could run a routing-sim that consults recent telemetry to estimate p95 for candidate chunking. keep it fast (<20ms) by using a cached quantile table per model/dim-bucket.
Priya: telemetry gap: Console only shows avg size and tail latency but not split suggestions or heatmap. we should add an "Embed Split Advisor" panel that shows heatmap of p95 by (dim bucket, chunk byte size) and a sample split plan for a given payload.
Sam: UX: make the advisor opt-in per-route because it needs extra metric ingestion. toggle on for 24h during troubleshooting. show cost delta if they follow the plan.
Ella: runtime change: router should support a header hint X-Embed-Dim-Hint with values single|mixed|auto. default auto. if preflight suggests single, router will prioritize coalescing by shape for that request id.
Jon: implementation note: we already tag requests with dim_shape but router decision must be O(1). so store last-minute quantiles in an in-memory ring and evaluate mix cost with a tiny lookup table. avoid calling external services in the hot path.
Priya: metrics ingestion: add metrics embeddings.dim_matrix.p95 with labels dim_bucket and chunk_bytes_bucket emitted once per minute. estimate cost: ~1200 series per model per region, ~30k extra series total, approx $1.8k/month.
Sam: add alerting: if preflight predicted_p95 > actual_p95 * 2 or gateway 413s > 5% for 10m, auto-open a support ticket and surface advisor to affected tenants.
Ella: rollout plan: canary 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% for preflight + router header handling. Console advisor behind feature flag. collect telemetry for 48h before enabling advisor for all.
Jon: QA: create synthetic load with mixed dims and large payloads. capture traces and set sample payload logger when gateway returns 413 or latency > route.slo*1.5. sampling 0.1% by default.
Priya: product follow-up: expose tenant preference (routing: prefer_latency|prefer_throughput|prefer_cost) on route settings with warning about possible throughput loss. include a link to advisor to help choice.
Sam: ok I'll stub the Console UI copy and wire the toggle to the feature flag system. Priya, can you add the ingestion cost line to the pricing doc?
Priya: yes. will add paragraph recommending chunk sizes and explicit example curl + header.
Ella: example preflight curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/preflight \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"num_vectors":1000, "dim_samples":[512,512,2048], "approx_bytes":12000000 }'
```
Sam: deploy-bot: schedule?
metrics-bot: canary deploy plan queued: router/embeddings-preflight v3 -> canary pool at 2026-04-08T03:00Z. metrichooks enabled for dim_matrix.p95.
Ella: sweet. I'll open the runbook and add the quick mitigation steps (force header single, split-by-dim guidance).
Jon: thanks. one more: update client SDKs to expose auto-preflight and split helper. I'll add API client PR.
Priya: great. closing loop here. will post advisor mockups in #design tomorrow.
